root_cause.full_fetch: Critical PR gates used fetch-depth 0, causing checkout to fetch every remote branch and tag in a repository with a large stale branch population.
root_cause.long_poll: Repository writer verification could synchronously poll for up to 360 seconds while an external candidate PR materialized.
root_cause.missing_gate: An open PR could occasionally have no canonical Required run on its exact head, leaving delivery stalled without a bounded recovery owner.
root_cause.stale_prs: Explicit retired and superseded PRs accumulated and polluted repository state.

prevention.checkout: Critical PR gates use shallow checkout and fetch or query only exact base/head state needed for their proof.
prevention.polling: Synchronous writer candidate polling is capped at 30 seconds and exits as WAITING_EXTERNAL with exact resumable identity.
prevention.supervisor: A single bounded scheduled supervisor redispatches Required only when the exact PR head has no run and safely closes only explicit retired/superseded candidates.
prevention.budgets: Supervisor dispatch and close operations are hard capped per cycle to prevent recovery fan-out.

evidence.observed_fetch: Required, Delivery Hygiene and Skill Projection previously used fetch-depth: 0.
evidence.observed_poll: Repository Writer Operational Verification previously used seq 1 72 with sleep 5.
evidence.invariant: Recovery must reduce work: no all-ref fetch, no unbounded synchronous polling, no age-only PR closing, and exact-head identity is preserved.
